newsitem.title: USA: Oregon's tax Measure 47 passes with 52 pct support.
newsitem.headline: Oregon's tax Measure 47 passes with 52 pct support.

text.p: A controversial Oregon tax measure that would limit property taxes was narrowly approved by voters, according local media reports.
Measure 47 passed with roughly 52 percent support, with 99 to 100 percent of votes counted, the reports said.

By cutting property taxes and capping their increase, Measure 47, which appeared on the November 5 state ballot, would reduce local government financial flexibility, Moody's Investors Service Inc has warned.

A recent state study concluded that local governments could lose from 20 to 22 percent of their budgets as a result of the measure. The loss statewide could reach $1 billion over a two-year period, analysts warned.
